'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold DS Knowledge And Defense (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Knowledge And Defense (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-knowledgeanddefense-pre.gif|label=Knowledge And Defense (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' cr v walkers
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
